ios.desc:
Trivia Snack is a fun trivia quiz game for friends and family. Quick rounds, no internet required, and completely ad free!

QUICK TRIVIA ROUNDS
Each round is 5 questions - short enough to play anywhere, anytime! Perfect for commutes, road trips, waiting rooms, or winding down at home. All questions are stored locally; no internet connection needed.

MULTIPLAYER PARTY GAME
Play solo or with up to 6 players in multiplayer mode! Pick fun codenames each round and see who comes out on top! Great for family game nights, parties, and group hangouts.

HUNDREDS OF CURATED TRIVIA QUESTIONS
Trivia Snack features hundreds of unique, human curated questions across animals, science, food, brands, history, and more — designed to be fun no matter your interests or age. Every question comes with extra context so you actually learn something new!

HOW TO PLAY
Answer 5 trivia questions per round. Multiple choice questions are worth 10 points, true/false are worth 5. Highest score wins. Simple, fast, and genuinely fun. 

AD FREE FOREVER
No ads. No subscriptions. One purchase gets you everything — including all future question packs, added free.

FAMILY FRIENDLY
Rated 4+. Questions are universally approachable and appropriate for all ages. No pop culture references that leave anyone out, designed for family friendly fun across all ages and interests!

Have Questions? Please contact us at freestyle.feedback@gmail.com. We love hearing about inquiries and feedback from potential customers! :)

Thank you for considering Trivia Snack! Have a blessed day!

quotes.text:
Hello HN Community!

I just launched Trivia Snack: a game built for quick, bite‑sized trivia with questions your whole friend group can enjoy.

There are no obscure references—just universally fun, family‑friendly questions.

My inspiration came from Google Assistant's Lucky Trivia, which was discontinued a couple of years ago. I loved playing it with my family, since it delivered a fast, light trivia experience with just a few questions. After failing to find another trivia app that offered something just as simple and fun, I decided to build my own.

Each question has been written by me, and the app is paid to reflect the time and effort that went into creating it. That said, if anyone here would like to try it for free, please let me know in a comment below. I’d be more than happy to send you a free promo code! :)

Thank you for reading!

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/trivia-snack/id6755155863
Android: Coming soon; please email me at freestyle.feedback@gmail.com if you are interested!
